question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing cheerleader, Claire is playing striker, Dave is playing goalkeeper, Eve is playing left midfielder, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing center midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Gertrude and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Fred and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Eve trade positions. Then, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) cheerleader
(C) striker
(D) goalkeeper
(E) left midfielder
(F) benchwarmer
(G) center midfielder
solution:
Position order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: (fullback, cheerleader, striker, goalkeeper, left midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder)
1. Gertrude ↔ Claire: (fullback, cheerleader, center midfielder, goalkeeper, left midfielder, benchwarmer, striker)
2. Alice ↔ Dave: (goalkeeper, cheerleader, center midfielder, fullback, left midfielder, benchwarmer, striker)
3. Fred ↔ Dave: (goalkeeper, cheerleader, center midfielder, benchwarmer, left midfielder, fullback, striker)
4. Claire ↔ Eve: (goalkeeper, cheerleader, left midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, fullback, striker)
5. Gertrude ↔ Eve: (goalkeeper, cheerleader, left midfielder, benchwarmer, striker, fullback, center midfielder)
6. Claire ↔ Gertrude: (goalkeeper, cheerleader, center midfielder, benchwarmer, striker, fullback, left midfielder)
7. Bob ↔ Gertrude: (goalkeeper, left midfielder, center midfielder, benchwarmer, striker, fullback, cheerleader)
Eve plays striker, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
